__broaden__.πρόφερε: προφέρω — bring forward, offer; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: μή … πρόφερε ’do not bring forward’ · also in a positive command: ’bring forward’ (πρόφερε κρατερὸν μένος)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’)
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’
